screens.name: Talk to VP (Saarthi thread)
screens.purpose: The front door: the client says or types what they want in Hinglish or English, and Saarthi plans, does the A1 work, and brings every external, spend or publish step back as a card with a diff, cost and risk that one tap (or a 1.2 s hold) approves.

states: Empty first visit: greeting plus job chips
Thinking: one line naming the work, e.g. 'Reading 1,240 rows…'

screens.beats: Best today: Sarvam Genie docked beside every builder tab (sarvam 03; it builds, deploys and runs campaigns per SAR-03) and Retell Conductor with per-setting diffs and page chips (RET-03, retell 41); ElevenLabs Architect is Alpha (elevenlabs 8-architect); none was exercised, so output is [U]. VP goes further on four points: the whole campaign runs end to end through the same tools as the public API (W10); cards are bound to object versions and an argument hash, with hold-to-confirm and three-outcome receipts (rejected.harvest.04/05); Hinglish voice input; and the Working-on pane keeps chat state as objects with URLs. Hypothesis until W10 and the 5-user sessions.

screens.beats: Vapi has the best trade-off display (vapi 33, 51), but its headline leaves out telephony and the 1.5 s wait (1,530 ms shown vs our measured 2,319 ms demo p50, l4b) and its scores have no scale. ElevenLabs explains every setting best (elevenlabs 44) but uses enums and whole seconds. Bolna's cost bar (bolna 16) has no latency, and its 500 + 900 ms sliders have no sum. Sarvam's docked test (sarvam 10) has no ms anywhere. 0 of 6 ship Hindi lexicon lists (WT §1.2). VP adds all-in INR including telephony, ms with a predicted-gap sum, Hindi lexicons, a lint against recitable lines, a throwing budget, and simulated Hinglish personas that gate publish. Hypothesis until the W3/W4 batteries.

screens.name: Hear-it-first onboarding
screens.purpose: Let a visitor hear and talk to a Hinglish agent before signing up, then carry them from sign-up to their own agent on a browser call in under 3 minutes, and to a ring on their own phone in 15 minutes or less.
screens.layout: Public page 1280: a forest band header with the wordmark; a split hero: on the left a serif headline and three job chips, on the right a large round Listen/Talk button with voice cards beneath; below, a one-line honesty strip and 'Make one for my business'. 390: headline, one 120 px round button, job chips as a horizontal scroller, voice cards stacked. Job chips: Motor renewal · EMI pre-due · Clinic appointment
Voice cards: 'Asha · Warm ▶ / Calm ▶ / Brisk ▶', the same line; each shows 'first audio 620 ms from India (n=5, 20 Oct, server)' or 'not measured'
Big button: 'Talk to her (2 min, uses your mic)' · secondary 'Just listen to a sample call'
Honesty strip: 'She tells people she's an AI, once and lightly. She never asks for payment on the call.'

screens.beats: Sarvam's homepage runs an anonymous Hindi EMI persona, but it denied being an AI in 6/6 calls and shows no numbers (R2 §1 [M]). Vapi's demo agent measured p50 2.32 s from the US with 35% collisions (l4b [M]). Retell's checklist and Sarvam's prompt hero are the best signed-in first runs (retell 71, sarvam 02); Exotel's is a 9-10 px banner (exotel-01). VP's first screen is a voice, in three registers, honest about being an AI, showing the reply gap it measured on that very call. Target: sign-up to first browser-call audio under 3 min (T0, unmeasured).

beyond: Hear it before sign-up: the same Hinglish line in three registers, a live demo that says it is an AI, and the reply gap measured on that very call in the visitor's browser (Sarvam's homepage demo denied being an AI 6/6, R2 §1)
A predicted reply gap bar in ms (ears + hold + brain + voice + phone leg) beside the measured India p50 with n and date; 0 of 6 dashboards show any gap
Evidence grades and 'not measured' in the client UI: every number says whether it was measured, computed, estimated or vendor-claimed, with n, date and vantage
A two-lane stereo player (caller above, agent below) with moment pins, and a transcript synced in native script, romanised and English
A compliance trace on every call: why this call was allowed (window in local time, suppression, basis, series, attempt count, disclosure spoken at 0:06)
A line-hazard ribbon over the brief showing where callers hung up, with intervals, labelled under-powered until n is enough
Agenda-ledger chips on every live call tile, so a manager sees what she has covered without listening
Approvals bound to an argument hash with a 1.2 s hold; spoken or typed 'haan launch karo' renders the card and never executes
The Today screen as a morning paper led by outcomes verified from the client's system of record, not call counts
'How she changed for you': each version as a story with before and after audio and honestly labelled deltas
The contact timeline as an auditable memory: each fact with the caller's exact words, play-from-here, consent ledger and forget
Indian money and time by default: lakh grouping, ₹ incl. GST beside every price, per-second billing, IST and the contact's local time
Three opt-in UI sound cues with an Indian timbre (soft santoor-like pluck), rate-limited and ducked during live listen
A wallet that shows money held for live calls and never shows a negative balance in normal type
Real-capture marketing: the public site can only show screens the app actually draws
risks: The serif and warm palette may read as traditional or less technical to developer buyers; test with a 5-second preference test against Vapi and Retell captures before locking
Anek may lack tabular figures or read poorly as Devanagari at 14 px; the specimen gate decides, with Noto Sans as the fallback
Older Android WebViews may shape Devanagari conjuncts badly; include them in the layout gate's device set
Sound cues may annoy and get muted; they stay opt-in, rate-limited and measured by mute rate
Hold-to-confirm may slow power users; it applies only to A2 actions and has a second-tap alternative
At launch most latency and outcome figures will read 'not measured', which can look empty; that state is designed as a first-class, confident look
The owner may reject the look a fourth time; show the visual review artifact (11 screens, both widths, both themes) before any build
'Saarthi' is common in Indian apps and is not trademark-checked; a brand screen may force the 'VP' fallback
Mission control performance with 50+ live calls on low-end phones is unmeasured; budget is 4 ms of script per frame on one canvas
Chat and pages can drift apart over time; one tool registry and the parity rule are the defence, checked by W10
Screens promise numbers that other modules must produce (predicted gap, verified outcomes, compliance trace); if a writer is missing, the screen must show 'not measured', never zero
Mood path labels may be read as emotion truth; keep 'signals, not diagnosis' until calibrated against human labels
